description: Pinned Tier A external Python repos for the ripr crash / parse-failure / runtime / gap-ID-stability sweep. Scaled set across supported shapes plus an unsupported bucket (sqlalchemy, expected fail-closed). Clone is opt-in (--clone) and off the default CI path.
limits: clone is opt-in (--clone) and never runs on the default CI path

repos.why: Click CLI library; large pytest suite; decorator-heavy argument parsing. Diff flips a stream-compat comparison return -> return_value gap.
Tiny single-module compatibility library; fast baseline. Diff edits a version predicate -> exercises fail-closed (mocked_module) on compat-shim code.
Retry library; compact pytest suite. Diff flips the stop_after_attempt boundary (>= -> >) -> return_value gap.
Jinja templating; pytest suite. Diff flips a method-validation predicate (not in -> in) in do_round -> predicate gap.
Async concurrency library; pytest suite. Diff flips a boundary (<= 0 -> < 0) in repeat() -> boundary gap.
Flask web framework; decorator-heavy; pytest suite. Diff changes a config-load predicate (not rv -> rv is None) in Config.from_envvar -> predicate gap.
SQLAlchemy ORM; metaclass/dynamic mapping (unsupported bucket); expected to fail closed. Diff flips a negative-index boundary (== -1 -> != -1) in _getitem.
structlog logging; pytest suite. Diff flips a key-validation boundary (<= space -> < space) in LogfmtRenderer.__call__ -> boundary gap.
